data.one_liner: Flutter widget for live or picture‑based QR code scanning using a pure‑Dart decoder.
data.what_it_does: Provides a camera preview widget that captures frames and decodes QR codes (and other supported formats) on iOS and Android. Supports live scanning, picture‑take scanning, and format filtering.
use_when: You need a QR/barcode scanner without native ML libraries
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution that works on both iOS and Android
You want to customize scanning parameters like crop area or orientation
avoid_when: You require Web or desktop scanning support
You need high‑performance real‑time scanning in debug mode
You depend on advanced ML features like face detection
strengths: Allows format filtering and custom cropping
data.setup_notes: Add iOS camera/microphone usage descriptions in Info.plist and set minSdkVersion 21 on Android; may need dependency_override for camera_android_camerax.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Native ML‑based scanning with broader platform support including Web

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: High‑performance on‑device ML scanning with extensive format support
